notes.subject: ותזנינה / זנו
notes.rationale: Wanem rif bilong pasin nogut i kamap tupela taim — kolel i lus long Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: מעכו
notes.rationale: Man i no agrilong mining: 'makmakim' (KJV 'pressed') o 'holim wantaim han' (ASV 'handled').

notes.subject: מעכו
notes.rationale: Tok מעכו i stap long Tanakh hia tasol.

translation: Na ol i wokim pasin nogut bilong meri long Mitsrayim; long taim ol i yangpela yet, ol i wokim pasin nogut bilong meri. Long wanem ples ol i makmakim susu bilong ol, na long sanpela ples ol i holim susu bilong taim ol i yet bin ples meri.
